### Henry Schein and Chooch AI Bring Full-Service AI Inventory Management to Health Systems and Medical Organizations Nationwide


10/06/2026


[Download this Press Release (opens in new window) PDF 320 KB](https://s21.q4cdn.com/686911487/files/doc_news/2026/Oct/06/Henry_Schein_Press-Release_Chooch_10-6-26.pdf)


***Healthcare Facilities Can Access Chooch’s AI-Powered Inventory Detection and Management Platform,* *Which Can Be Paired with Henry Schein’s Complete Supply Chain Services***


****


**MELVILLE, NY** – October 6, 2026 – Henry Schein, Inc. (Nasdaq: HSIC) and[Chooch AI](https://www.chooch.com/) have reached an agreement to collaborate to help health systems, medical offices, and medical labs simplify inventory management, reduce time spent manually tracking supplies, and help ensure the products they need are available when and where they are needed. Chooch’s AI-powered inventory management technology is now available as part of Henry Schein’s fully managed Supply Chain Services, giving customers access to inventory technology and supply chain support through one comprehensive solution.


Chooch AI is an artificial intelligence (AI) platform that uses advanced large vision models and computer vision technologies, together with advanced AI workflows, processes, and technologies, to monitor inventory levels in real time and automatically trigger timely inventory ordering, fulfillment, and replenishment with minimal human intervention.


“Managing inventory can require health systems to coordinate technology, inventory oversight, and supply fulfillment across multiple providers,” said Ty Ford, Vice President and General Manager, Henry Schein U.S. Medical Sales. “By adding Chooch AI’s technology platform to our suite of supply chain service offerings, we can deliver a single, accountable solution that manages the process end-to-end, from setup through ongoing supply fulfillment.”


With the combination of Henry Schein’s fully managed Supply Chain Services and Chooch’s platform, health system administrators can now oversee and manage the entire supply acquisition and management process across all locations, removing these manual tasks from their professional and clinical staff’s workload.


“By working with Henry Schein, we’ve helped bridge the gap between data and delivery, driving visibility, efficiency, and control,” said Anubhav Saxena, CEO of Chooch AI. “Together, we are ensuring that our customers’ products are ordered, fulfilled, and in the right hands, at the right place, at the right time. This way, clinically trained staff can focus on improved patient care and reduced risk.”


Chooch’s solution is available now through Henry Schein for health systems and medical offices of all sizes. Henry Schein and Chooch AI work together to manage onboarding, enabling organizations to have the solution up and running quickly and efficiently. To learn more or schedule a consultation,[click here](https://www.henryschein.com/en-us/supplies/medical/chooch) .


**About Chooch AI**


Chooch AI provides advanced AI-powered[hospital inventory management](https://urldefense.com/v3/__https:/www.chooch.com/solutions/hospital-inventory-management/__;!!C8D7Pa6reTSs!cuxuL4NVNMJUD5uiaE5YIFtUH_My5kZNlOZvpKEjsmaFcWNccNsHTd6HkDYCT06ju9TbbO83wrDjPqRMs4ty6u-jefCqlC01xZI$) to hospitals, health systems, and clinical environments. This enables organizations to always have automated real time visibility and requisitioning of their monitored supplies, supporting hundreds of millions of dollars in supplies across each of these enterprises. Through sustained clinical and operational excellence, the system eliminates critical supply stock outs and avoids overstocking supplies. Chooch AI unlocks valuable time for clinicians to make better clinical care decisions and reduces administrative delays. Chooch protects the supply chain process by ensuring the highest levels of healthcare security and compliance, with advanced certifications like ISO 27001, ISO 9000 and SOC2


For more information, visit[www.chooch.com](https://urldefense.com/v3/__http:/www.chooch.com/__;!!C8D7Pa6reTSs!cuxuL4NVNMJUD5uiaE5YIFtUH_My5kZNlOZvpKEjsmaFcWNccNsHTd6HkDYCT06ju9TbbO83wrDjPqRMs4ty6u-jefCqFtReDbQ$)


****


**About Henry Schein, Inc.**


Henry Schein, Inc. (Nasdaq: HSIC) is a products, services, and technology platforms company for healthcare customers. With more than 25,000 Team Schein Members worldwide, the Company's network of trusted advisors provides more than 1 million customers globally with more than 300 valued solutions that help improve operational success and clinical outcomes. Our Business, Clinical, Technology, and Supply Chain solutions help office-based dental and medical practitioners work more efficiently so they can provide quality care more effectively. These solutions also support dental laboratories, government and institutional healthcare clinics, as well as other alternate care sites.


Henry Schein operates through a centralized and automated distribution network, with a selection of more than 300,000 branded products and Henry Schein corporate brand products in our distribution centers.


A FORTUNE 500 Company and a member of the S&P 500® index, Henry Schein is headquartered in Melville, N.Y., and has operations or affiliates in 34 countries and territories. The Company's sales reached $13.2 billion in 2025, and have grown at a compound annual rate of approximately 11.0 percent since Henry Schein became a public company in 1995.


For more information, visit Henry Schein at www.henryschein.com.
